what: A screen-height video or photo plate behind the section is pinned to the screen from the moment the section’s top edge touches the top of the screen, and the text and photos inside the section scroll up over it. Once the section’s bottom edge leaves the top of the screen, the plate returns to the section’s top position. Scrim type: a plate whose lower half is filled solid with the stage color (63% to 90%, top edge 15%) rises over the video. Veil type: the video is laid faintly at .2 opacity over a white plate

options.[data-fx-part=backdrop]: Back panel (child) — put a video or img inside. It must be present
options.[data-fx-part=lift]: Rising content panel (child) — bottom-edge detection and the scrim gradient attach here. If none, the section itself
options.look: scrim (dark panel rises covering · first page intro) or veil (video at .2 opacity over a white panel · News · Rooms background)
options.--fx-media-alpha: Back panel video/photo opacity (via style), default 1 · veil type is .2

use: …
note: The original doesn’t use sticky, on every scroll (batched into one rAF) it toggles a class between absolute ↔ fixed. So the panel doesn’t jump when passing the section’s top edge, and when the section ends the panel returns to the section’s top so it doesn’t show through outside the section. Inside an inner scroll panel (data-fx-scroller) it measures from the panel’s top edge
